findings.title: Reject non-positive flusher process counts before building the shard map
findings.body: `--flusher-processes` accepts arbitrary integers, but negative values make `num_processes` negative. The shard-assignment loop then computes an index that is absent from `process_to_shards_map`, causing a `KeyError` during consumer startup whenever partitions are assigned. A value of `0` is also silently treated as the number of shards because of `max_processes or len(...)`, despite the option describing it as a maximum. Validate that the CLI value is positive (or explicitly define and implement zero semantics) before constructing the process map.
